source.title: Belfast News-Letter, 27 April 1933, p. 16 ("DOWN LOCAL ELECTIONS: Contests Likely For Four County Council Seats")
source.publisher: Belfast News-Letter (via the Irish Newspaper Archives)
source.check: returned unopposed: the only nomination left for the division (Belfast News-Letter, 27 April 1933)

note: Triennial election of Down County Council. Nominations were received at the County Courthouse, Downpatrick, on 26 April 1933; polls took place on Thursday 25 May 1933 in the two divisions still contested, Castlewellan and Portaferry, and the other eighteen were returned unopposed (Belfast News-Letter, 24 April, 27 April, 4 May and 27 May 1933). No party labels are printed, so none are given. Returned unopposed.
